body.summary: Layout review of research/people-graph-360.html identifies four P0 AAA contrast failures across 20+ instances — --ink-mute, --indigo, --moss, and the rt-stamp timestamp all fall below 7:1 at small-text sizes and must be remediated before the page is referenced in a board deck or briefing. The single highest-leverage structural improvement is a sticky left-gutter TOC behind a min-width: 1200px breakpoint, which turns a passive reading experience into a navigable reference document. Full critique at /research/people-graph-360-layout-review.md.
p0_items: --ink-mute (#6c7180) 4.14:1 on paper — 9 instances at sub-14px (masthead slug, meta keys, era-yr, compmat sub-label, sources counter, footer). Fix: --ink-3-aaa (#3d4456, 8.27:1)

--indigo (#3d4d7d) 6.99:1 — 0.01 below AAA threshold at 10+ small-text locations (section numbers, TOC bullets, distlist labels, vignette headers, impl-card headers, pres-link). Fix: --indigo-deep (#2a3658, 10.11:1)
--moss (#4a5d3a) 6.12:1 — fails in .p-shipped pill and .lg-v legend text. Fix: --moss-deep (#3a4a2c, 8.13:1)
rt-stamp text rgba(14,22,38,.55) ~3.87:1 — the one place on every Stratum page where we hardcode opacity instead of using a AAA token. Fix: --ink-3-aaa
body.single_change: Sticky left-gutter TOC at @media (min-width: 1200px) — elevates a 6,400-word reference document from linear scroll to navigable artifact
body.ship_as_is_verdict: No. P0 contrast failures must be closed before board read or any external reference. P1 (sticky TOC) is a structural debt worth closing in the same pass.
body.o1_note: O-1 advanced: all WCAG contrast ratios computed against AAA thresholds. Four token families identified as failing. Remediation path documented with exact replacement tokens. No waiver issued — these are fixable in a single CSS patch.
